findings.claim: TransitionOrderStatus TOCTOU race allows double stock commit. The state-machine validation (findUnique at line 38) happens OUTSIDE the Prisma transaction (line 57). Two concurrent webhook deliveries for the same order can both read status=RESERVED, both pass the VALID_TRANSITIONS check, and both enter separate transactions that call commitStock — double-decrementing stock and reservedStock.
proof_refs: Lines 38-57: findUnique reads order.status outside the transaction
Lines 57-113: the transaction mutates stock based on the stale read
No SELECT FOR UPDATE or optimistic locking protects the read-check-write sequence

findings.claim: Webhook handler reads payment status from payload fields that MP does not send. MercadoPago payment webhooks send data: { id: <payment_id> } — only the payment ID. The handler reads paymentData.status and paymentData.external_reference (lines 121, 128), which are NOT present in real MP webhook payloads. The handler will throw 'missing status' or 'missing external_reference' for every real webhook, returning 500 and preventing any order from transitioning to PAID.
proof_refs: Line 121: const paymentStatus = (paymentData?.status as string) ?? body.status as string — neither data.status nor body.status exist in MP's actual webhook schema
The handler must call Payment.get({ id: data.id }) to retrieve the full payment object
The test fixtures (route.test.ts lines 44-52) inject non-standard fields into the mock body, masking this defect

findings.claim: Stock validation reads stale data outside transaction — concurrent checkouts can over-reserve. In CreateReservedOrder, stock availability is checked at lines 78-95 by reading product.stock and product.reservedStock outside the transaction. The reservedStock increment happens inside the transaction at lines 159-171. Between the read and the transaction, a concurrent checkout can reserve the same units.
proof_refs: Lines 78-86: available = availableStock - reservedStock (read outside tx)
Lines 119-180: transaction increments reservedStock without re-checking availability
No database constraint prevents reservedStock > stock

findings.claim: Orphaned RESERVED order when MP preference creation fails — cart CONVERTED, no recovery path. If the MercadoPago API call fails (lines 187-223), the Prisma transaction has already committed: order is RESERVED, stock is reserved, cart is CONVERTED. The catch block throws but does not roll back the transaction.
proof_refs: Lines 119-180: transaction commits order + stock reservation + cart CONVERTED
Lines 187-223: MP preference creation is outside the transaction; failure leaves orphaned state
actions.ts:217: idempotency check requires recentOrder.preferenceId to be truthy
Line 289: error redirect goes to /checkout?error=... with no order_id

findings.claim: Webhook deduplication allows re-processing of failed events on MP retry. The dedup check (line 55-61) only matches WebhookLog entries where processed=true. If processing fails (line 93-98 sets processed=false), and MercadoPago retries the same event, the handler creates a SECOND WebhookLog entry and re-processes the event.
proof_refs: Lines 55-61: findFirst filters on processed: true
Lines 93-98: on failure, processed is set to false
A retried event will not match the existing unprocessed log, creating a duplicate entry
